title: C++: Templates
description: Write a template function to find the maximum of two values of any type.

steps.title: Template Max
steps.description: Write a template function `T max(T a, T b)` that returns the larger of two values. Test with int (10, 20) and double (3.14, 2.71).
hints: template <typename T> T max(T a, T b) { return (a > b) ? a : b; }
The compiler generates code for each type used.
